run_checksum: run the checksum function to compute the SHA-256 hash of a given file path
review_checksum: review the checksum function that reads a file in binary mode and returns its SHA-256 hex digest
refactor_checksum: refactor the checksum function to support streaming large files without loading them entirely into memory
test_checksum: test the checksum function by computing the SHA-256 hash of a known file and verifying the output
summarize_checksum: summarize the checksum function which uses hashlib.sha256 to compute a file's hash in 64KB blocks
